newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila SEC approves Boulevard Properties IPO.
newsitem.headline: Manila SEC approves Boulevard Properties IPO.

text.p: The Securities and Exchange Commission said on Thursday it has approved the initial public offering of Boulevard Properties Holdings Inc.
Boulevard Properties will offer 500 million shares at the par value of one peso, representing 50 percent of the authorised capital stock of 1.0 billion shares.
The company, which is chaired by Jose Marcel Panlilio, intends to use the proceeds of the IPO for various property projects.
These include its share in the Fort Bonifacio development project in the financial district of Makati, Philippines; and the proposed Grand Boulevard Kim Lien Hotel in Hanoi, Vietnam.
The issue manager and lead underwriter of the offer is Philippine National Bank.
